answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the dune of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the terrace until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the fable of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
